component.name: Admin
component.documentation: Marks a player entity with administrator privileges

component.name: AdornmentHandles
component.documentation: 3D drag handles drawn on an adornee entity

component.name: AirControl
component.documentation: Enables classic air strafing: preserves speed when coasting, accelerates when turning into a strafe

component.name: AutoLocomotion
component.documentation: Automatic walk/idle/jump clip selection from velocity and state

component.name: AutoRotate
component.documentation: The character turns to the move direction

component.name: Background
component.documentation: What the camera sees behind the world: a color, or the sky component on this entity

component.name: Backpack
component.documentation: Holds equipped and stored tool prefab ids

component.name: BackpackSlot
component.documentation: Assigns a tool to an unbounded backpack slot

component.name: Billboard
component.documentation: Camera-facing text anchored to the entity

component.name: BillboardOnTop
component.documentation: The Billboard draws over walls instead of behind them

component.name: BodyPart
component.documentation: Which body part this child entity is

component.name: CharacterAnimation
component.documentation: Attaches an Animator once the six body parts exist

component.name: CharacterGravity
component.documentation: The character falls along its own Gravity Vector and stands up along its own Up Direction

component.name: CharacterPhysics
component.documentation: Opt-in dynamic torso body; Health and Locomotion alone are inert data

component.name: CharacterRig
component.documentation: Kinematic limb bodies for the BodyPart children, ridden on the torso and pose

component.name: CharacterSurfaceAlign
component.documentation: While the character stands on ground, its Up Direction turns to the floor under its feet, so it walks up walls and around planets

component.name: CharacterTuning
component.documentation: World-wide locomotion and PD force controller tuning

component.name: ClickDetector
component.documentation: Enables pointer picking and clicks on this entity or its ancestors

component.name: Climbable
component.documentation: Characters that walk into this part climb it, as they climb a truss

component.name: Clouds
component.documentation: Volumetric shell and lighting, drawn with the Atmosphere Sky only

component.name: Collider
component.documentation: Collision shape, decoupled from the visual; None opts out

component.name: CollisionGroup
component.documentation: Membership in a named collision group; absent means group 0

component.name: ConsoleAction
component.documentation: engine action this console button fires

component.name: ConsolePrompt
component.documentation: tag identifying the console command line prompt

component.name: ConsoleRowLine
component.documentation: tag identifying console row line text child

component.name: ConsoleRowPrefix
component.documentation: tag identifying console row prefix child

component.name: ContinuousCollision
component.documentation: Predicts where the part will collide instead of moving it and correcting afterwards, so a small fast part stops passing through moving parts; slower to compute

component.name: CoreMenuAction
component.documentation: engine action this core Menu button fires; the Name does nothing

component.name: CoreMenuPage
component.documentation: page of the core Menu this subtree belongs to

component.name: CoreSettingBind
component.documentation: device setting this core Menu widget shows or steps

component.name: Decal
component.documentation: An image on one face of the parent part, held as a child entity. Its own Color tints and Transparency fades it

component.name: DisplayName
component.documentation: Account display name shown on nametags and the leaderboard

component.name: Fog
component.documentation: Fades objects into the fog color with distance from the camera; the sky stays clear

component.name: HingeJoint
component.documentation: Groups two rigid bodies together, constraining them to move like connected by a hinge

component.name: Identity
component.documentation: Session fact on the character root; distinct from Name

component.name: Invulnerable
component.documentation: TakeDamage does nothing while this tag exists

component.name: Kinematic
component.documentation: Kinematic motion policy for a simulated physics body

component.name: LastHit
component.documentation: The server adds this component when damage lands

component.name: Lifetime
component.documentation: Countdown to destruction; the server subtracts the tick time and deletes the entity at zero

component.name: Light
component.documentation: Local point light. A SpotCone on the entity makes it a spot light

component.name: LightShadowOff
component.documentation: The light casts no shadow. Absence means it casts

component.name: LimbAttachment
component.documentation: Joint frames; rewritten from the rig asset at attach

component.name: MultiJump
component.documentation: The character jumps again in the air each time jump is pressed, up to Max Jumps before it lands

component.name: NoContactFriction
component.documentation: Zero contact friction while present; the FSM holds it during GettingUp

component.name: Player
component.documentation: Marks a connected player entity

component.name: PrefabInstance
component.documentation: Names the prefab this entity instantiates; saving a prefab stores the reference instead of the expanded subtree

component.name: RenderDisabled
component.documentation: No render slot; physics, replication, and raycasts untouched

component.name: RootMotion
component.documentation: Applies root bone animation translation to character movement, modeling Unity Animator.applyRootMotion

component.name: RopeConstraint
component.documentation: Keeps the connected object no further than Distance away; it can move closer

component.name: Seat
component.documentation: A character that lands on this part sits on it and stays there until it jumps

component.name: SessionOwner
component.documentation: The user a character answers to; set by the session binding

component.name: ShadowOff
component.documentation: No shadow from this entity; the shadow passes skip it

component.name: Shape
component.documentation: Part shape identity as a value

component.name: Sound
component.documentation: Plays an audio asset either 2D or positioned in 3D space

component.name: SoundAttenuation
component.documentation: Distance attenuation settings for 3D positional audio

component.name: SoundBus
component.documentation: Routes audio playback to a specific mix bus

component.name: SoundCone
component.documentation: Directional cone a 3D sound radiates along its Front face

component.name: SoundPolyphony
component.documentation: Caps concurrent voice playback for this sound

component.name: SpotCone
component.documentation: Cone half-angles in radians. Presence makes the Light a spot light

component.name: SurfaceAppearance
component.documentation: Per-mesh PBR texture overrides; a zero slot means no override

component.name: SuspensionConfig
component.documentation: Makes this entity a wheel of its parent part: a ray from the Suspension Hardpoint finds the ground, and a spring and damper push the parent up there

component.name: SwingTwistJoint
component.documentation: Authored swing-twist joint limit between this entity's body and its ECS parent's; materialized by the consuming system (e.g. character knockdown)

component.name: TargetYaw
component.documentation: Target yaw angle in radians

component.name: Team
component.documentation: Groups entities that fight together

component.name: TextMenuItem
component.documentation: edit this text context menu item runs on the focused text box

component.name: Timer
component.documentation: A countdown timer; it fires Timeout when it reaches the end of its Wait Time

component.name: TimerAutostart
component.documentation: The timer starts when the entity enters the world

component.name: TimerOneShot
component.documentation: The timer stops after reaching the end; without the component it restarts

component.name: TimerPaused
component.documentation: The timer does not count down while it is paused

component.name: TirePatchConfig
component.documentation: Makes this part a wheel whose grip peaks at a small slip and falls as it spins, locks or slides; it rolls about its local Y axis

component.name: Transient
component.documentation: Marks a session-only entity omitted when saving the place

component.name: Trigger
component.documentation: Other parts and characters pass through this part and fire its Touched and TouchEnded signals

component.name: UIArrowButton
component.documentation: A button that draws a filled arrow in its text color

component.name: UIBusyBar
component.documentation: Sweeps a segment across the bar for work of unknown length; the client draws it, no script runs

component.name: UICheckbox
component.documentation: A square box that shows a check mark while checked

component.name: UIChecked
component.documentation: The box shows its check mark

component.name: UIClickable
component.documentation: Opts into hit-testing and click/press events

component.name: UIClips
component.documentation: Scissors the descendants to this entity's rect

component.name: UIColorButton
component.documentation: Draws a color swatch with a checkerboard under its alpha

component.name: UIColorPicker
component.documentation: A saturation and value square beside a hue bar

component.name: UIColorPickerState
component.documentation: The color a picker holds; a drag writes these three numbers and never the style

component.name: UIColumnWidths
component.documentation: Gives each of the first 16 grid columns its own width

component.name: UIConsoleText
component.documentation: resolved console text sequence and part

component.name: UICorner
component.documentation: Rounds the corners of the plate and the stroke

component.name: UIDialog
component.documentation: Asks the player to confirm or cancel; dims the screen behind it and centers it in its parent

component.name: UIDisabled
component.documentation: Draws the control dim and refuses the pointer and the key; absent means usable

component.name: UIDropdown
component.documentation: A button that shows the selected option and opens a list of every option below itself

component.name: UIFitColumns
component.documentation: Sizes each grid column to its widest cell

component.name: UIFloatSlider
component.documentation: A slider whose value moves freely from Min to Max

component.name: UIFloatSliderValue
component.documentation: The value a float slider holds; a drag writes these four bytes and never the range

component.name: UIFoldable
component.documentation: A section the player folds by its header strip; folded it hides its children

component.name: UIFrame
component.documentation: Filled rectangle background; the plate behind every Gui

component.name: UIFreezeRows
component.documentation: Pins the top lines of a scrolling grid, as a table header

component.name: UIGraph
component.documentation: Container that pans and zooms child nodes and connects ports with wires

component.name: UIGraphConfig
component.documentation: Input limits and step for a node graph view

component.name: UIGraphLink
component.documentation: Connects two ports in a UIGraph with a bezier wire

component.name: UIGraphPort
component.documentation: Marks a UI element as a connectable node graph port

component.name: UIGridLayout
component.documentation: Steps the children through uniform cells and owns their position and size

component.name: UIHeaderCell
component.documentation: Draws the grid cell as a column header with a sort arrow; a click sorts by its column

component.name: UIHidden
component.documentation: Hides the entity and its subtree; the renderer skips it

component.name: UIIcon
component.documentation: Places an icon beside a caption on one entity

component.name: UIImage
component.documentation: Draws a texture inside the rect of this element

component.name: UIImageStates
component.documentation: Swaps the image of a button on hover, press and disable

component.name: UIItemList
component.documentation: Lets the player pick one child with a click or the arrow keys and highlights it

component.name: UIItemListState
component.documentation: The child a list holds picked; a pick writes these two bytes and never the style

component.name: UIJoystick
component.documentation: A thumbstick the player drags; the state component has the direction

component.name: UIJoystickState
component.documentation: Where a thumbstick points; a drag writes these bytes and never the style

component.name: UILinkButton
component.documentation: Underlines the text of this element and opens the address in the browser when the player clicks it

component.name: UIListClipper
component.documentation: Makes the children of a scrolling frame a pool the engine binds to the rows in view

component.name: UIListLayout
component.documentation: Stacks the children and owns their position, anchor, and the scroll canvas height; child size stays authored

component.name: UIListStripe
component.documentation: Tints every other row of this list or grid, counted in the order the layout places them

component.name: UIMenu
component.documentation: Opens the children as a menu panel at this element

component.name: UIMenuCheck
component.documentation: A checkable item in a menu panel

component.name: UIMenuOpen
component.documentation: The menu panel of this element is open

component.name: UIMenuRadio
component.documentation: A radio item in a menu panel

component.name: UIMultiSelect
component.documentation: Enables multi-selection across children in layout order

component.name: UINumberField
component.documentation: Turns the text input into a number box that clamps, steps on the arrow keys, and scrubs on a drag

component.name: UINumberValue
component.documentation: The number a number box holds; a drag writes these four bytes and never the limits

component.name: UIOrder
component.documentation: Draw and list order among siblings

component.name: UIPlot
component.documentation: Draws the newest samples as a line or bar graph

component.name: UIPopup
component.documentation: Shows this element over every other one at its parent rect while it holds UIPopupOpen

component.name: UIPopupOpen
component.documentation: The popup is open; a press outside it closes it

component.name: UIProgressBar
component.documentation: Draws a track and a fill up to the progress; the player cannot drag it

component.name: UIProgressValue
component.documentation: The progress a progress bar shows; a change writes these four bytes and never the colors

component.name: UIRadialFill
component.documentation: Shows the image of this element up to an angle

component.name: UIRadioButton
component.documentation: A circle that shows a dot while selected; one radio of a group is selected at a time

component.name: UIRadioGroup
component.documentation: Radios with the same group number select one at a time

component.name: UIRadioSelected
component.documentation: The radio shows its dot; selecting it clears the rest of its group

component.name: UIRect
component.documentation: Screen-space rectangle; scale is a parent fraction, offset pixels

component.name: UIRepeat
component.documentation: Fires Activated on press and again while the press holds

component.name: UIResizableColumns
component.documentation: Lets the player drag the border between two grid columns to resize them

component.name: UIRoot
component.documentation: ScreenGui: top-level entity whose descendants form one overlay

component.name: UIScrollBar
component.documentation: Draws a scroll bar whose thumb the player drags from Min to Max minus Page

component.name: UIScrollBarValue
component.documentation: The value a scroll bar holds; a drag writes these four bytes and never the range

component.name: UIScrollFollowing
component.documentation: Keeps a scrolling frame at its end as the canvas grows

component.name: UIScrollingFrame
component.documentation: Clips the children and moves them with the wheel; a zero canvas takes the extent of a vertical list layout

component.name: UISearchBox
component.documentation: Turns the text input into a search box with a clear button; Enter sets Text

component.name: UISelected
component.documentation: Marks a child element selected

component.name: UISeparator
component.documentation: A divider line across the element, with an optional label

component.name: UIShortcut
component.documentation: The key label of a menu item as an interned name id

component.name: UISlider
component.documentation: A stepped track the player drags; the value is a place in a list, never a free number

component.name: UISliderArt
component.documentation: Paints the track, the fill and the thumb of the slider with textures

component.name: UISliderFormat
component.documentation: Draws the slider value over the track in this format

component.name: UISliderRange
component.documentation: Adds an upper thumb, so the slider picks a low and a high place

component.name: UISliderState
component.documentation: The place a slider holds; a drag writes these two bytes and never the style

component.name: UISliderTicks
component.documentation: Draws a notch across the track at every step, under the thumb

component.name: UIStroke
component.documentation: Border line around the plate of this Gui

component.name: UISurface
component.documentation: Part-face canvas for 2D UI elements

component.name: UISurfaceAlwaysOnTop
component.documentation: The UISurface draws over parts in front instead of behind them

component.name: UITableBorders
component.documentation: Draws lines between the columns and rows of this grid

component.name: UITableHeader
component.documentation: Holds the sort column and direction a click on a header cell of this grid steps

component.name: UITabs
component.documentation: Shows one child page and draws a strip of clickable tabs

component.name: UITextInput
component.documentation: Editable text input; cursor and focus state stay client-side

component.name: UITextSource
component.documentation: The authored text as an interned name id

component.name: UITextStyle
component.documentation: Text style, including horizontal and vertical alignment

component.name: UITextWrapped
component.documentation: Breaks the text into lines at the width of the rect

component.name: UIToggle
component.documentation: A two-state switch with a pill track and a round knob

component.name: UIToggleArt
component.documentation: Skins the track and knob of a switch with textures

component.name: UIToggleButton
component.documentation: A click latches the button pressed; the next click releases it

component.name: UIToggleMixed
component.documentation: The knob rests halfway for a group that is partly on

component.name: UIToggleOn
component.documentation: The switch is in the on position

component.name: UITreeFolded
component.documentation: Hides the children of this tree item or foldable section; absent shows them

component.name: UITreeView
component.documentation: Lays out the descendants as an indented tree the player folds; the UIItemListState component has the pick

component.name: UIVectorField
component.documentation: Two or three numbers side by side that the player drags

component.name: UIVectorValue
component.documentation: The numbers a vector field holds; a drag writes these twelve bytes and never the style

component.name: UIWindow
component.documentation: A panel the player moves by its title strip, resizes by its grip and raises with a press

component.name: UvTransform
component.documentation: Moves, repeats and turns the textures a part samples through its mesh UVs, and the image of a Decal. Triplanar and stud materials ignore it

component.name: VehicleSeat
component.documentation: A seat whose driver's movement keys set Throttle and Steer for scripts that drive the vehicle

component.name: Velocity
component.documentation: Linear velocity in studs/s

component.name: Weld
component.documentation: Rigid weld to another entity; the weld system creates the joint and removes this component when the joint breaks

component.name: WeldBreak
component.documentation: Reaction force or torque that breaks the weld on this entity; the weld system removes the Weld component past either

component.name: Worn
component.documentation: Session fact on an accessory root worn through AddAccessory
